## Checklist

- [ ] This PR references the issue it closes (`Closes #<number>` above)
- [ ] Tests were added for new or changed behavior, and existing tests pass (`cargo test` + `pnpm test`)
- [ ] TDD was followed — the failing test was written before the implementation ([Engineering Standards](https://github.com/OlaGreat/starbound-realms/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#engineering-standards))
- [ ] Mutation testing was performed where relevant — the new test was confirmed to fail against a deliberate mutant ([Mutation Testing](https://github.com/OlaGreat/starbound-realms/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#mutation-testing))
- [ ] CI is green (format, lint, contract tests, SDK/backend/frontend tests)
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior or public interfaces changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
